gap_details.2011-2012: No roster anywhere. Old-site current_residents.html (Wayback 2011-07, CC 2012-05) is a stale ~2007-09 list; Drupal subdomain neurosurgery.med.nyu.edu launched 2012-12 but meet-our-residents first archived 2014-01-18; July-2012 resident handbook PDF not archived; CC-MAIN-2012/2013 checked. Reconstructed 14 alumni-confirmed people only (Kalhorn PGY7; Bassani, Pacione PGY6; the 11 2013-14 residents entering 2007-2011). Incomplete: alumni list covers only academically employed graduates, so non-academic 2012/2013 grads and any leavers are invisible. PHASE 2: re-audited all hosts 2011-06..2013-09 (gapaudit: old www.med.nyu.edu/neurosurgery, neurosurgery.med.nyu.edu, GME, education, surgery), followed every link on the old residency/education pages (only the stale current_residents.html) and on the Drupal education-training page (2012-12/2013-02 captures link meet-our-residents, never archived before 2014-01-18). Found the Aug-2013 Drupal resident-alumni page: academic alumni only, latest entries '10, so no help. PubMed affiliation mining 2010-2014 (NYU neurosurgery): no unidentified resident except Matthew M. Kang (NYU/Bellevue neurosurgery affiliation 2007-2012, Regions Hospital St Paul from 2013; probably a 2011 or 2012 non-academic graduate; not placed because his year is unknown).
gap_details.2012-2013: Same as 2011-12: no roster capture (Wayback, CC-MAIN-2012, 2013-20, 2013-48). Reconstructed 14 (Bassani, Pacione PGY7 via alumni 2013; 12 people later seen in 2013-14 incl. Brunswick PGY1). The 2012 entering class shows only Brunswick; a second 2012 intern who left before 2013-14 could be hidden. PHASE 2: same searches as 2011-12, nothing new. The 2015 resident handbook says the program 'trains 2 residents per year'. Every entry class from 2006 to 2011 has 2-3 members; only 2012 (Brunswick alone) is short. PubMed 2012-2014 shows no unexplained NYU neurosurgery author.
gap_details.2013-2014: Observed: Wayback 2014-01-18 neurosurgery.med.nyu.edu meet-our-residents, flat list (15). PGY inferred from entry class.
gap_details.2017-2018: Wayback has no roster capture 2017-01..2019-07; Common Crawl has meet-our-residents in CC-MAIN-2017-09..2018-22. Used CC-MAIN-2017-47 (2017-11-20), 15 names.
gap_details.2018-2019: Observed via Wayback 2019-07-23 capture, CONTENT-DATED 2018-19 (Brunswick, grad 2019, still listed; no 2019 interns).
gap_details.2019-2020: PHASE 2: OBSERVED (partial list). Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2020-24, 2020-06-06, med.nyu.edu/neurosurgery/research/residents-research: the sidebar 'Residents in Research' list is the 2018-19 list plus the two 2019 interns (Cordelia Orillac, Albert Liu). Brunswick (graduated 2019 per alumni page) is still listed, so he is omitted as stale. 18 residents loaded as source_type 'other'. No third 2019 intern appears. Replaces the phase-1 reconstruction.
gap_details.2023-2024: Oct-2023 capture is stale (identical to 2022-23); used 2024-05-22 capture (first version with 2023 interns, 2023 grads gone, no 2024 interns).
gap_details.2026-2027: Live page re-fetched 2026-09-28: still identical to 2025-26 (PGYs not advanced, no 2026 interns). Not loaded. PubMed 2026 (Jan-Sep): 17 of the 18 residents at PGY-1..6 in 2025-26 publish with an NYU neurosurgery affiliation in 2026 (all but Derek Huell), but these papers mostly reflect 2025-26 work. The 2026 intern class is unknown.

departures.name: Harold Westley Phillips
departures.note: Confirmed on both rosters: NYU PGY2 2016-17 (last on CC 2017-04-30) -> UCLA our-residents 'H. Westley Phillips' PGY3 2017-18 (Wayback 2017-12-07) to PGY7 2021-22.

departures.name: Mohamed Khattab
departures.note: PubMed: Dept of Radiation Oncology, Vanderbilt 2018-2022 (PMID 30622928), then Minneapolis Radiation Oncology. Switched to radiation oncology.

joiners.name: Roee Ber
joiners.note: Absent from 2017-18 (CC 2017-11-20, 2018-05-26); PGY2 2018-19 with the 2017 class; graduated 2024. Came from Tel Aviv Sourasky (not a US program). He took the place Phillips/Khattab left, so the 2017 class had 4 and the 2019 class 2.

problems: PGY labels exist only on 2025+ pages; all earlier PGYs inferred from entry class (alumni graduation year - 7, or first year listed as intern), consistent across all years and with the 2025 PGY-labelled pages. Alumni page lists Marian M. Bercu (2017) and Aryan M. Ali (2020), who never appear on any resident roster (2013-14..2018-19 cover their would-be years); Bercu's 2020 PubMed affiliation is NYU pediatric neurosurgery -> treated as pediatric fellows, NOT inserted into training_history. 31 alumni graduations (2012-2025) inserted. Pre-2013-14 years cannot be observed. Common Crawl ran 2012-2014.41 (partial, killed; 2012/2013 crawls complete, nothing new) and 2017-2019 (complete, no failures). PHASE 2: CC-MAIN-2020-05 cluster.idx failed twice ('size failed') for edu,nyu,med)/neurosurgery/. It is not needed now that 2019-20 is observed. Training_history rows added 2026-09-28: Phillips (transferred), Khattab (switched_specialty), Ber (transfer-in row, start 2018 PGY2), Orillac and Liu (PGY-terminal roster, 2026).

2011-2012.reason: All entry classes 2006-2011 are at complement (2-3) and bracketed by the 2013-14 roster. A leaver could hide only in the 2005 or 2012 class. The hidden people are likely non-academic 2012 graduates (e.g. Kang), which are completions, not attrition.

2012-2013.reason: The 2012 entry class shows only Brunswick against a 2-a-year complement. A second 2012 intern who left during PGY-1 (before Jan 2014) would be invisible. No roster, news, PubMed or CC evidence either way.

2019-2020.reason: Partial or stale-plus-additions list (CC 2020-06-06), but it names the 2019 interns and everyone bracketed by 2018-19 and 2020-21. Only an intern who joined and left inside 2019-20 without being listed could hide.

2026-2027.reason: Current year, not yet published (live page stale 2026-09-28). A 2025-26 resident who left in summer 2026, and the 2026 intern class, cannot be seen. This is right-censoring; recheck when the page updates.
